description.value: The Roost is a working 10-acre farm in North Saanich that grows and mills its own wheat for daily fresh bread, tends a 2-acre vineyard producing estate wines, and raises free-range hens and sheep — making the food genuinely farm-to-table rather than a marketing claim. The property encompasses a farm bakery, a Vineyard Bistro with breakfast and lunch counter service, a winery tasting room, and guided farm tours. A short ride from the Victoria International Airport ferry corridor, it offers cyclists a genuinely pastoral stop with regional cuisine and local wine.

address.value: 9100 East Saanich Road, North Saanich, BC V8M 2B4

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website fully loads and confirms a real, operating farm bakery, bistro, and winery at 9100 East Saanich Road. Phone (250) 655-0075 matches OSM; however, the postcode differs — OSM has V8L1H5 while the website consistently shows V8M 2B4, so the website address is used. Takeout is confirmed by a dedicated Take Out section and online ordering; gluten-free options are confirmed by website text ('gluten free options') and a customer review ('superb menu offering many gluten free options'). Bike parking, washrooms, and water refill are not mentioned anywhere in the website content.
concerns: Postcode discrepancy: OSM has V8L1H5 but website consistently shows V8M 2B4; website value used.
OSM name 'The Roost Farm Bakery' is narrower than the business's full operating name 'Roost Vineyard Bistro, Farm Bakery & Winery' as shown on the website.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operating farm bakery and bistro with an active website, consistent phone number, and confirmed regular hours — a distinctive and welcoming stop for touring cyclists on the Saanich Peninsula.
